The Epistle of James.text: What does James 2:4 call those who discriminate this way?

Keeping most of the law is sufficient

The Epistle of James.text: What law does James 2:12 say believers should be judged by?
options: The law that gives freedom, the law of liberty
The law of the land only

The Epistle of James.text: What does James 2:13 say about judgment for those who show no mercy?

The Epistle of James.text: What does James 1:5-6 teach about the proper approach to prayer for wisdom?

Ask only once in a lifetime

The Epistle of James.text: What does James 4:3 identify as a reason some prayers are not answered?
options: Asking with wrong motives, to spend it on selfish pleasures

The Epistle of James.text: What instruction does James 5:13 give to someone in trouble?
options: They should seek a priest exclusively

The Epistle of James.text: What promise is given regarding the prayer offered in faith for the sick, per James 5:15?

The Epistle of James.text: What does James 5:16 encourage believers to do with one another?

The Epistle of James.text: What does James 5:16 say about the prayer of a righteous person?

It is only effective in public
It requires perfect righteousness with no sin at all

The Epistle of James.text: What overall connection does James draw between faith, works, and prayer throughout the epistle?

Faith alone is sufficient without deeds or prayer

options: Because true faith naturally produces visible, tangible expressions in a believer's conduct
Because works alone can save without faith
Because James rejected the idea of faith entirely
Because action is more important than belief
The Epistle of James.correct_answer: Because true faith naturally produces visible, tangible expressions in a believer's conduct

The Epistle of James.text: What overall lesson does the Epistle of James teach believers about the Christian life?
options: A living, working faith, expressed through impartial love and fervent prayer, is essential to authentic Christianity
Faith without any action is sufficient for salvation
Works alone guarantee salvation without faith
Prayer and love are secondary to correct doctrine
The Epistle of James.correct_answer: A living, working faith, expressed through impartial love and fervent prayer, is essential to authentic Christianity

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What does 1 Peter 2:12 urge believers to do among unbelievers, pagans?

Only the sins of the apostles
The sins of the Roman soldiers only

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What title does 1 Peter 2:25 give Jesus in relation to believers?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What positive attitude should characterize elders' service, per 1 Peter 5:2?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What warning does 1 Peter 5:3 give elders about their leadership style?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What reward does 1 Peter 5:4 promise faithful elders?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.correct_answer: The crown of glory that will never fade away, when the Chief Shepherd appears

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What instruction does 1 Peter 5:5 give to younger members of the church?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What attitude does 1 Peter 5:5 say all believers should clothe themselves with toward one another?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What instruction does 1 Peter 5:6 give regarding humbling oneself?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What instruction does 1 Peter 5:7 give about anxiety?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What instruction does 1 Peter 5:9 give about resisting the devil?

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What promise does 1 Peter 5:10 give after a period of suffering?

Suffering will continue indefinitely with no relief
Believers must restore themselves through their own effort

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What doxology concludes this section, in 1 Peter 5:11?

"The Lord bless you and keep you" only

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What overall theme unites 1 Peter 5:1-11 regarding interpersonal relationships among Christians?

Citizenship and faith are entirely unrelated

Good citizenship has no bearing on evangelism

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What connection exists between suffering unjustly and following Christ's example, per 1 Peter 2:21-24?

Godly leadership requires strict, unquestioned authority

To discourage all forms of church leadership

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What overall picture of Christian community emerges from 1 Peter 2 and 5?
options: A community marked by respectful conduct in society, Christlike endurance of suffering, and humble mutual care within the church
A community isolated entirely from society
A community defined by strict hierarchy and control
A community indifferent to suffering and humility

The Epistle of 1 Peter.text: What overall lesson does the Epistle of 1 Peter teach believers about relating to both society and the church?

Christians should conform fully to society while ignoring church community
